free_tier.stated: 2 GB storage + 5 GB bandwidth on Free; 2 projects

per_object_cap.stated: 50MB file size limit on the Free plan (5GB on Pro); the first-party pricing page now publishes this per-object cap.

egress.terms: 5 GB bandwidth/month on Free. 2.5x the storage, so it is a real wall but not as lopsided as Supabase.

tooling: Appwrite SDKs (web, flutter, node, python, dart), REST + GraphQL API, `appwrite` CLI; storage buckets expose file preview/download endpoints; S3-compatible adapter exists for self-host
chaining: 2 projects x 2 GB = 4 GB per account; per-project caps on buckets ('1 Database, 1 Bucket, 2 Functions per project') mean a bucket cannot be sharded inside a project. Accounts are the only multiplier. Self-hosting is free and unlimited but that is paid compute, not a free tier.
limits_note: 1 bucket per project on Free; 1 member; 750K executions; free projects paused after 1 week inactivity; 2-project cap.

identity_cost.detail: a name, email address and password are the stated registration fields; GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket and Google social sign-in are offered (first-party sign-up page)

reliability_note: Same inactivity-pause pattern as Supabase/Nhost (1 week). Project limit of 2 is enforced per account.

evidence.proved: the inactivity pause and 2-project cap are confirmed against the live first-party page
evidence.quote: Free projects are paused after 1 week of inactivity. Limit of 2 projects.
